<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.7.16 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(services): add Services to the SDKs and CLI by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2031
### Fixes
* fix: pass clippy on Rust 1.100 and build the port test by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2074
* fix(network): revalidate SNI DNS bindings on reconnect by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2078
* fix(runtime): update libkrun and multigrain firmware by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2087
* fix(sdk): decode every cloud sandbox status by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2090
* fix(agentd): keep bulk cleanup bursts from stopping the guest by @TheRealSibasishBehera in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2085
### Refactoring
* refactor(cloud): use canonical sandbox change endpoints by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2088
### CI
* ci(release): add Ubuntu package mirror fallback by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2048
### Maintenance
* chore(release): bump microsandbox to 0.7.16 by @appcypher in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2065
### Other changes
* Revise Open Code examples in agents.mdx by @sebastiankutschbach in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2079

## New Contributors
* @sebastiankutschbach made their first contribution in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/2079

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/compare/v0.7.15...v0.7.16
